instruction: Using Terminal, generate a spoken reminder with the text "Dinner is in the oven, so check it again in twenty minutes." and export it as a WAV file saved to "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_2_3.wav".
reference_command: SHERPA_ONNX_RUNTIME_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/runtime" SHERPA_ONNX_MODEL_DIR="$HOME/.openclaw/tools/sherpa-onnx-tts/models/vits-piper-en_US-lessac-high" node "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa-onnx-tts.cjs" -o "$HOME/Desktop/sherpa_tts_2_3.wav" "Dinner is in the oven, so check it again in twenty minutes."
